accounts.isolatedTarget: KCoder account isolation: signed-in account data only
accounts.sharedTarget: Shared SSH environment: the same SSH user shares history; enable account isolation for teams
accounts.revokeHelp: This stops this account’s running tasks and terminals without deleting history or changing SSH administration. The account can log in again afterward.
accounts.migrationHelp: Exports contain identities and password hashes, not conversations or host UID mappings. Keep the export private. Disabling an account blocks new connections.
accounts.connectionHelp: When enabled, this connection requires signing in with a KCoder account; sign in, sign out and switch accounts on the saved connection without creating a new one.
accounts.logoutWarning: Signing out closes this target’s connections and interrupts its active work.
accounts.switchWarning: Switching first signs out the current account and disconnects its tasks on this connection; enter the new username and password afterwards.

sso.waiting: Complete sign-in in your browser. This connection will update automatically.
sso.usernameRequired: Enter your KCoder account username first.
sso.expired: The original sign-in expired. Start a new sign-in.
sso.failed: Organization sign-in failed or is unavailable. Retry or ask the administrator to verify the provider and callback configuration.

sshConnections.title: SSH connections
sshConnections.description: Save connections for additional SSH terminals opened by this Gateway. These connections do not change Agent runtime targets or require KCoder on the remote host.
sshConnections.formSubtitle: Fill in the connection details; once saved it becomes available in the terminal panel.
sshConnections.loadFailed: Unable to load SSH connections. Check the Gateway connection and retry.
sshConnections.empty: No SSH connections yet. Add one, then open it from the terminal panel.
sshConnections.saveFailed: Unable to save the SSH connection. Your changes are kept; check the Gateway connection and retry.
sshConnections.deleteFailed: Unable to delete the SSH connection. It is still listed; check the Gateway connection and retry.
sshConnections.keyHelp: Absolute path on the Gateway host, not on this browser's computer. Use a regular file up to 1 MiB, not a symbolic link. The key file is not uploaded.
sshConnections.credentialsHelp: Save a password here to reuse it when connecting. Leave blank to keep the existing password. Changing the host or username clears it. Windows uses user-bound DPAPI; other Gateways use a private local encryption key. Key passphrases remain connection-only.
sshConnections.passwordSaved: Password saved; it is never shown again.
sshConnections.passwordWillClear: The password will be removed when you save.
sshConnections.agentHelp: Uses the SSH agent available to the Gateway process, not the browser's SSH agent. Windows Gateways do not support SSH agent; use password or private key authentication instead.
sshConnections.deleteDescription: Delete “{{name}}” from saved connections. Remote files and Agent runtime targets will not be deleted.
sshConnections.discardDescription: Your unsaved SSH connection changes will be lost.

validation.labelInvalid: Use a connection name of at most 120 UTF-8 bytes without control characters.
validation.keyInvalid: Enter an absolute private key path on the Gateway host.
validation.passwordInvalid: The password must not contain NUL and must be at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes.
validation.hostInvalid: Enter a hostname or IP address without a URL, username, or spaces.
validation.portInvalid: Enter a whole port number from 1 to 65535.
validation.usernameInvalid: Enter a valid SSH username without spaces or a leading hyphen.
validation.keyRequired: Enter the private key path on the Gateway host.

starting_description: Preparing files, conversations, and your local workspace. This should only take a moment.
failed_description: The workspace could not start. Please retry.
error_not_running: The local workspace service is not running
error_not_ready: The local workspace service is not ready

targets.title: Runtime targets
targets.description: Manage KCoder app-servers on this computer or over SSH. SSH can use your agent or ~/.ssh/config.
targets.addDescription: Start with identity and connection details. Less common options are under Advanced settings.
targets.editDescription: Editing {{id}}. A runtime target ID cannot be changed after creation.
targets.advancedSubtitle: SSH, launch command, and environment configuration options.
targets.loadFailedHelp: Check the gateway connection and retry. Existing configuration will not be cleared.
targets.healthUnavailable: Connection status could not be refreshed
targets.healthUnavailableHelp: Runtime target configuration is still editable. Check the gateway or network and retry.
targets.emptyDescription: Add a local or SSH target to make it available to tasks.
targets.savedHelp: The target can now be selected from the device list.
targets.testFailedHelp: Check the target address, SSH authentication, and app-server command, then retry.
targets.saveFailedHelp: Your configuration is preserved. Correct the reported issue and retry.
targets.deleteFailedHelp: The target is still available. Check the gateway data directory and retry.

errors.unauthorized: The gateway session expired. Sign in again, then retry.
errors.http: The gateway returned HTTP {{status}}. Check the gateway service, then retry.
errors.invalidResponse: The gateway returned an invalid response. Update or restart the gateway, then retry.
errors.connection: The gateway could not be reached. Check the network and gateway address, then retry.

validation.invalidId: Use letters, numbers, periods, underscores, or hyphens, up to 64 characters
validation.duplicateId: This runtime target ID already exists
validation.invalidPort: Port must be an integer from 1 to 65535
validation.invalidWorkspace: Workspace must be an absolute path
validation.invalidAccountUsername: Use 2–32 lowercase letters, digits, dots, hyphens or underscores.
validation.invalidSettingsFile: Settings file must be an absolute path

targets.acceptHostKey: Accept a new host key on first connection
targets.acceptHostKeyHelp: A changed host key will still be rejected.
targets.noSandboxEnabledWarning: The Chromium sandbox is disabled. Use this target only in an already isolated virtual machine.
targets.noSandboxConfirmDescription: This reduces browser process isolation and is only appropriate for an already isolated, trusted virtual machine.
targets.discardDescription: Continuing will discard the unsaved values in the current runtime target.
targets.deleteDescription: The target will be removed from the device list and new tasks that depend on it cannot start. This cannot be undone.
targets.storageNote: Configuration is stored in the gateway private data directory, not in the project .kcoder directory.

modelConfiguration.title: Effective model settings
modelConfiguration.requestOverrides: Request fields overridden by model JSON
modelConfiguration.boundaryHelp: New settings apply at the next idle turn. An accepted turn retains its snapshot. Extra request fields can override the configured defaults shown here.
modelConfiguration.capabilityHelp: Undeclared capabilities are unknown. Configuration flags do not prove upstream support or enable reasoning by themselves.
modelConfiguration.policyHelp: Control policies are user declarations, not verified vendor behavior. Hidden controls do not hide effective settings here.
modelConfiguration.toolCountHelp: Registered counts reflect role and profile filtering. Request counts require an actual request snapshot.

providerSettings.reasoningPolicyHelp: This is your declaration, not proof of vendor support. Fixed modes must match the effort and extra body. Optional mode requires at least one enabled effort and no reasoning override in JSON.
providerSettings.reasoningPolicyConflict: Reasoning policy conflicts; nothing was saved. Check reasoning_policy, reasoning capability, default effort and extra_body. Fixed modes require matching explicit parameters; optional mode requires declared efforts without JSON overrides.

organization.privateBoundary: Account administrators manage membership and policy. Member private content and credentials require their own access permission.
organization.historyBoundary: Policy changes govern new reads and actions. Content already included in earlier model context cannot be remotely withdrawn.
organization.exportDenied: Audit export requires a separate grant for this scope.
organization.failed: Organization governance is unavailable or your current identity lacks permission. Ask the host administrator to verify enrollment and reconnect.

resourceEditor.help: Use the original provider resource reference. Policy changes govern new reads and actions; membership administration does not grant private content or credentials.
resourceEditor.subject: Choose a member or role
resourceEditor.privateLocked: Only the original owner can change this private resource.
resourceEditor.wholeAudit: All redacted events in this organization
resourceEditor.changed: The policy changed while this draft was open. Reload it before saving.
resourceEditor.nativeSourceHelp: This declares where a native publication belongs. The resource owner remains its policy manager. It grants no content access and does not prove that a source exists; the publisher identity, registered workspace and current permissions are checked again when reading. Saved source locators cannot be rebound.
resourceEditor.nativeReferenceInvalid: Use a publication reference with owner and publicationId. Do not include a body, credential or local path.

execution.title: Model access and execution budgets
execution.boundary: Rules require both the selected member/workspace resource grants and this exact provider, model and endpoint. Saving policy does not grant credentials or prove that a model is reachable. Budget enforcement also requires the host administrator to initialize the original native budget service.
execution.changed: The organization policy changed. Reload its current version before saving this draft.
execution.registerWorkspace: Register a workspace resource before adding a model route.
execution.budgetBoundary: Limits apply together across organization, account, workspace and task. Empty fields add no limit. Explicit administrator changes keep the original budget family, currency, usage and unknown holds. A later window starts after the original ends. Cost remains unknown without verified pricing.
execution.invalid: Complete valid model identities, members, workspaces and budget windows before saving.
execution.unavailable: This target does not expose model and budget policy editing. Upgrade its account service to configure execution policy.

budgetService.title: Native budget status
budgetService.boundary: Read the original shared journal. Usage includes conservative reservations; unknown charges remain held. Refreshing does not initialize, repair or reset the journal.
budgetService.unconfirmed: The operation is unconfirmed. Refresh to reconcile the original service before trying any further action.
budgetService.ready: The original budget service is available.
budgetService.preparing: Initialization is unconfirmed. Existing state is retained; an operator must reconcile it.
budgetService.uninitialized: Budgets are configured, but the native service has not been initialized.
budgetService.notCurrent: The observed journal window differs from the current configuration. Reading does not apply new limits.
budgetService.notObserved: No usage has been confirmed for this window.
